voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: South Africa, July nineteen-oh-nine. One evening, the steamer Harlow saw a ship behind her, pouring smoke.
After dark, her lights. Then two great flashes, seconds apart. When they cleared, the lights were gone.
The Harlow's officers put it down to bush fires ashore. In Durban next day, the captain reported nothing.
Two months later, the captain heard a liner was missing: the Waratah, out of Durban the night before, with two hundred and eleven aboard.
He became sure he had seen her. The Waratah's owners doubted it. The Waratah has never been found.
